Disappointing results from the picture I showed and asked for. I asked for individual lashes since I have sensitive eyes, a natural look. Instead she did clusters about 3-4 lashes per lash which added so much heaviness, unnatural and cheap looking lashes. Glue was also way too much and uncomfortable.  They only care about your money and not actual look you are going for. Seems there is no management, customer service or professionalism at all here. If you complain they will treat you as the problem instead of fixing the issue they caused. Over $150 dollars later for a terrible look overall. There are much better lash salons with better staff and results ladies!
